name: SCANNER
summary: A tape head for images and video. The head sweeps, the bed moves underneath it, and the recording is built from strips taken at different moments — so the distortion is time rather than a filter. Composed as a spec, which is what an agent writes.

surface.hint: record a picture one strip at a time — slit-scan, flatbed warp, or a tape of pure motion

_roots_note: Optional, matching EFFECTS. With nothing bound the app is honest about having no source rather than showing an empty stage that looks like a working recorder.
_calls_note: /api/effects/sources is CROSS-APP on purpose: listing what is in the media root is a capability studio-effects already serves, and declaring a call rather than reimplementing it is the whole reason the manifest grew a calls field.

provider._note: Same provider as EFFECTS. The scanner is a different surface over the same capability, not a second engine — the motion response reads the field the effects tier already computes.
